keyword: buy a mortar sprayer not a trailer pump

title.en: A Mortar or Plaster Purchase Opens the Xingtai Spraying Hub
title.zh: 砂浆或石膏采购要打开邢台的喷涂分类

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists spraying machines separately from trailer pumps. If the order is mortar, plaster or a spraying particle size, open that hub. Do not order Electric 20 for a ≤2 mm mortar line.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把喷涂机与拖泵分开列出。如果订单是砂浆、石膏或喷涂粒径，请打开该分类。不要为 ≤2 mm 的砂浆行去订电动20。

h1.en: Start a Spraying Purchase on the Spraying Pages
h1.zh: 喷涂采购从喷涂页面开始

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai tells buyers who need a mortar, plaster or concrete spraying machine to leave the trailer-pump hubs. The selection note names Type 311 for fine mortar ≤2 mm / 2 m³/h, Type 511 for ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h on 380 V, Type 511 diesel when that window has no 380 V, and other spraying rows for their own printed windows. Those machines are not trailer pumps. Open [/en/products/spraying-machines/](/en/products/spraying-machines/) and the single page. Price is quote-only.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）让需要砂浆、石膏或混凝土喷涂机的买家离开拖泵分类。选型说明写明：细砂浆 ≤2 mm / 2 m³/h 看 311，有 380 V 时 ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h 看 511，同一窗口没有 380 V 时看 511 柴油机，其他喷涂行看各自印出的窗口。这些机器不是拖泵。请打开 [/zh/products/spraying-machines/](/zh/products/spraying-machines/) 和单页。价格只询价。

heading.en: The first split is the machine family

body.en: A trailer pump page prints aggregate in centimetres and a pipeline distance. A sprayer page prints particle size in millimetres and a hose diameter. Mixing those units on one order is the wrong family.
body.zh: 拖泵页用厘米写骨料，并写管路距离。喷涂页用毫米写粒径，并写软管直径。把这些单位写进同一张订单，就是错了类别。

body.en: Spraying pages say quote only, the same commercial rule as the pumps: no numeric price on the site. Send particle size, the printed output and whether you have 380 V or diesel to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 喷涂页写询价报价，商务规则与泵相同：网站上没有数字价格。把粒径、印出的输送量，以及你有 380 V 还是柴油，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

heading.en: Do not borrow a pump’s m³/h

body.en: Type 311 prints 2 m³/h. That is not Electric 10 Series at 21 m³/h, and it is not a reason to order the electric pump for a ≤2 mm mortar.
body.zh: 311 印 2 m³/h。那不是电动10系列的 21 m³/h，也不能因此为 ≤2 mm 砂浆去订电动泵。

question.en: Is Type 311 a small trailer pump?

answer.en: No. It prints 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 15 m / 5 m and particle ≤2 mm.
answer.zh: 不是。它印 4 kW、2 m³/h、3–5 MPa、15 m / 5 m、粒径 ≤2 mm。
